However, the teammate's session log is empty and no teammate changes were applied to the workspace: the test suite for `src/decision` (such as `tests/decision/derive.test.ts`, which `snapshot-builder.ts` references in its comments) was not added, and any remaining parts of the migration owned by the teammate are absent (for example, `src/compiler/select-unit-inputs.ts`, `src/compiler/materialize-units.ts`, `src/compiler/materialize-stage.ts`, and `src/runtime/run-materialization.ts` are still untouched). Because the teammate's share was not executed, the overall migration and test coverage for `src/decision` are incomplete.
